# Bright Futures — Fall Cohort

> One of two same-named cohorts. This is the **Fall** cohort (upcoming). Distinct from the
> wrapping [Bright Futures — Spring Cohort](bright-futures-spring.md).

- **Goal / definition of done:** enroll and mentor a **new cohort of ~60 high-school juniors and
  seniors** starting September 2026, driving college applications and enrollment.
- **Owner:** [Andre Willis](../people/andre-willis.md).
- **Status:** **active — in setup.** Recruiting students and matching volunteer mentors now; roster
  to be finalized mid-August (see [commitments](../commitments.md)). Co-recruiting mentors with
  [CityReach](../people/marcus-odom.md).

## Open items
- Finalize the Fall cohort roster and mentor matches.
- Confirm the kickoff event date and family orientation.
